entry.title: Spectral analysis of random-to-random Markov chains
entry.summary: We compute the eigenvalues and eigenspaces of random-to-random Markov chains. We use a family of maps which reveal a remarkable recursive structure of the eigenspaces, yielding an explicit and effective construction of all eigenbases starting from bases of the kernels.
entry.arxiv:comment: 51 pages; 11 figures; version 3: fixed typos and other expository improvements

entry.title: The $q$-deformed random-to-random family in the Hecke algebra
entry.summary: We generalize Reiner--Saliola--Welker's well-known but mysterious family of *$k$-random-to-random shuffles* from Markov chains on symmetric groups to Markov chains on Type-$A$ Iwahori--Hecke algebras. We prove that these operators pairwise commute, and that their eigenvalues are polynomials in $q$ with non-negative integer coefficients; we express these eigenvalues in a closed form as certain symmetric function evaluations (which is new even for $q=1$). We show that these operators are simultaneously diagonalizable for almost all $q$, and combinatorially express the dimension of the subalgebra they generate. Our work generalizes and extends work of Reiner--Saliola--Welker and Lafrenière for the symmetric group, and simplifies all known proofs in this case.
entry.arxiv:comment: 40 pages main text + 17 pages of appendices. v4 adds many new results, including better formulas for the eigenvalues (as evaluations of supersymmetric functions) and the dimension of the subalgebra generated by the operators, and a diagonalizability claim for all "2n-safe" q. The proofs of the eigenvalues have been rewritten as well. Comments are welcome!
